purpose: Train every compared Backbone through the same normalized probability law for recorded duration codes and the same existing quantity objective.

scope.delivery: Korean session text and machine-readable local JSON

observation_model.recorded_code: D = max(1, round(T)); when top-coded D = min(top_code, D)
observation_model.metric_unit: negative natural log of dimensionless recorded-code probability
observation_model.numerics: float64 log-CDF/log-survival differences with indexed active branches; differentiable to model parameters; no probability floor or loss clamp
observation_model.unresolved_probability: fail explicitly, never silently change the objective

data_boundary.materialization: lazy filter to train and validation before collection
data_boundary.before_loader_cast: finite nonnegative integers; Instacart values no greater than 30; reject other split labels in direct training input
data_boundary.zero_policy: existing loader merges raw zero into code one
data_boundary.interpretation: The round/clamp latent law is a modeling choice for transformed records, not a verified account of how physical event times were recorded. Raw zero gaps are not separately modeled.
data_boundary.future_target: use hidden state at preceding observed event; target quantity is masked and target event cannot write memory

initialization.population: exact train-target population under the existing lookback and maximum sequence-length loader
initialization.initial_sigma: population standard deviation of log(train_duration / time_scale), strictly greater than sigma floor
initialization.restriction: Top-coded observations are used only for initialization statistics; these are not asserted to be unbiased latent distribution estimates.
initialization.validation_usage: selection only; no fitting of time scale or initialization statistics

joint_objective.optimization: both tasks update the encoder; no detach or task-separated training

checkpoint_contract.selector: strict earliest finite validation raw-quantity RMSE minimum
checkpoint_contract.reporting: RMSE, MAE, quantity strata and recorded-time NLL from the same selected checkpoint; any last-epoch metrics labeled separately
checkpoint_contract.identity: source revision, training arguments and interface metadata including observation law and train statistics
checkpoint_contract.restore: model, optimizer, RNG, train-loader generator, selection state and history
checkpoint_contract.legacy_cache: new role cannot accept the historical no-identity cache fallback
checkpoint_contract.bare_state_dict: Insufficient to select an observation law; consumers must restore and validate checkpoint metadata as the supported trainer does.

compatibility.without_observation_contract: log_observation_dt delegates exactly to historical log_f_dt
compatibility.old_roles_and_active_candidates: remain on their existing objective; not silently migrated

synthetic_cpu: probability mass normalization and top-code boundary
finite gradients in narrow bins and extreme tails
five-Backbone time and quantity encoder gradients
same batch traces across five Backbones
cached checkpoint and exact interrupted resume
three dataset contracts through the production CLI using fabricated Parquet

remaining: Implement the selected new Backbone and its capacity-matched control, then bind both to this same objective in an explicit role.
Freeze real train-only statistics, source bundle, evaluation gates, server assignment and resource/time limits in a separate GPU execution contract.
After execution approval, qualify native CUDA numerical behavior and actual step/memory costs before comparison training.
Treat scientific suitability and generalization as unverified until the approved real-data comparisons complete.
